description: This is a source code file defining an immutable singleton class 'ImmutableJsonObjectNull' representing a JSON null value as a JSON object. It provides methods to interact with JSON fields, but since it represents 'null', most methods return default or empty values.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonObjectNull
classes.description: An immutable singleton class implementing JsonObject and JsonNull, representing a JSON null value as an object.

methods.description: Overrides for setting multiple fields; no operation performed, returns this singleton.
